title: Extract and harden transcript transition bookkeeping
outcome: SessionPaneView.scroll.ts is over the active TypeScript module threshold and the new content-transition classifier adds self-contained pure logic plus four unpruned per-scroll-key maps. Extract transition construction/classification into a focused module with direct unit tests, prune per-key state on teardown, and bound the drainAnimationFrames test helper so a self-rescheduling callback fails diagnostically instead of hanging Vitest.
acceptance: Pure content-transition construction/classification lives outside SessionPaneView.scroll.ts with direct unit tests; all per-scroll-key transition/signature/prompt maps are pruned with pane teardown; drainAnimationFrames has a finite diagnostic bound; existing scroll behavior and full frontend gates remain green.
